info.title: AI-Based Symptom Checker API
info.description: Informational triage aid backend providing symptom collection, prediction orchestration, and risk engine evaluation.

get.description: Returns current service status and deployed version.

post.description: Registers a new user account with an Argon2id-hashed password. Rejects duplicate email addresses with a 409 Conflict error. Returns the created account representation without password hashes.

422.description: Validation error on email or password

post.summary: Authenticate user and set session cookie
post.description: Verifies credentials using Argon2id, generates a signed JWT, and sets it in an HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax cookie. The JWT is never returned in the JSON response.

401.description: Invalid credentials or missing/expired authentication token

post.description: Clears the HttpOnly session cookie. Safely succeeds whether the user is actively logged in or already logged out.

get.description: Returns the account profile for the currently authenticated user extracted from the HttpOnly session cookie.

401.description: Missing, invalid, or expired session token

post.description: Initializes a new assessment session linked to a mandatory user consent record. Returns initial START lifecycle state.

400.description: Invalid consent identifier or consent missing

get.description: Fetches current status and metadata of an assessment session.
Retrieves detailed state snapshot including active symptoms, clarification loop counter, and lifecycle phase.

post.summary: Send a message in the assessment conversation
post.description: Appends a user chat message to the assessment dialogue and returns the recorded user message, assistant clarification, and next state.

409.description: Operation invalid for current assessment state

get.description: Returns sequential ordered history of messages in the assessment.

schema.title: Response Get Messages Api V1 Assessments  Id  Messages Get

get.description: Retrieves recognized symptoms list for the assessment.

schema.title: Response Get Symptoms Api V1 Assessments  Id  Symptoms Get

patch.description: Allows user to confirm, edit, add, or delete symptoms prior to triage evaluation.

schema.title: Response Update Symptoms Api V1 Assessments  Id  Symptoms Patch

409.description: Operation invalid for current assessment state

post.description: Submits confirmed symptoms to the deterministic risk engine and condition prediction models. Transitions state to COMPLETED.

409.description: Operation invalid for current assessment state

get.summary: Get assessment result and triage outcome
get.description: Retrieves final clinical triage outcome, candidate conditions with categorical confidence, guidance, limitations, and medical disclaimer.

409.description: Operation invalid for current assessment state

post.summary: Upload and validate an optional symptom image
post.description: Receives an optional symptom image (JPEG, PNG, WebP up to 5 MB), validates magic bytes, strips all EXIF/metadata, and processes strictly in volatile memory without writing to disk or database (DR-06).

400.description: Image validation failed (size, format, or corrupted content)

422.description: Validation error on path parameter or multipart form

post.description: Save acceptance of the supplied policy version and return its ID.

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.default: This is not a medical diagnosis. Always consult a qualified healthcare professional.

AssessmentResult.title: AssessmentResult
AssessmentResult.description:
Final triage assessment result and safety guidance.

Attributes:
    assessment_id: Foreign key to the evaluated assessment.
    risk_level: Deterministic risk tier (SELF_CARE, CONSULT_DOCTOR, URGENT).
    conditions: Ranked candidate conditions with categorical confidence.
    guidance: General self-care, warning signs, and monitoring advice.
    referral: Healthcare referral details.
    limitations: Disclosed limitations of the automated informational triage aid.
    model_version: Version identifier of the risk engine and models.
    disclaimer: Mandatory medical safety disclaimer.
    created_at: UTC timestamp when the result was composed.

AssessmentState.title: AssessmentState
AssessmentState.description:
Lifecycle states of an assessment session.

Flow: START -> SYMPTOM_COLLECTION -> CLARIFYING -> CONFIRMING -> READY ->
ANALYZING -> COMPLETED

isLowConfidence.title: Islowconfidence
isLowConfidence.description: Whether low confidence was flagged due to capped clarification loop

AssessmentStateResponse.title: AssessmentStateResponse
AssessmentStateResponse.description: Detailed state snapshot for state polling and validation.

file.title: File
file.description: Symptom photo (JPEG, PNG, WebP up to 5 MB)

confidence.description: Categorical confidence label (never a raw percentage)

Condition.title: Condition
Condition.description:
A possible condition associated with the reported symptoms.

Attributes:
    name: Clinical or plain-language name of the potential condition.
    confidence: Categorical confidence tier (Likely, Possible, Less likely).
    rank: Rank index based on symptom-overlap scoring (1 = highest match).
    icd10_code: Standard ICD-10 clinical coding classification, if available.
    specialty: Recommended medical specialty for clinical evaluation.
    description: Brief informational summary of the condition.
    why: Plain-language contributing factors, e.g. "Because you reported
        fever and joint pain." (FR-24, S2-NIS-2).

ConfidenceLabel.title: ConfidenceLabel
ConfidenceLabel.description:
Categorical confidence labels presented to users.

Raw statistical scores are never exposed directly to users (AI_RULES.md §2).

ConsentRequest.title: ConsentRequest
ConsentRequest.description: Policy version accepted by the user.

ConsentResponse.title: ConsentResponse
ConsentResponse.description: ID of the persisted consent record.

Duration.title: Duration
Duration.description:
Structured duration of a symptom.

Attributes:
    value: Non-negative duration length.
    unit: Duration time unit (HOUR, DAY, WEEK, MONTH, YEAR).

DurationUnit.title: DurationUnit
DurationUnit.description: Time units for symptom duration tracking.

ErrorResponse.title: ErrorResponse
ErrorResponse.description:
Uniform error response schema returned to clients.

Attributes:
    code: Machine-readable uppercase snake_case error identifier.
    message: Safe, human-readable error description.
    details: Optional additional diagnostic details.
    request_id: Correlated request identifier matching the X-Request-ID header.

HealthResponse.title: HealthResponse
HealthResponse.description:
Schema for health check response.

Attributes:
    status: Service health status, defaults to 'ok'.
    version: Deployed version or git commit SHA.

ReferralInfo.title: ReferralInfo
ReferralInfo.description:
Clinical referral guidance based on triage severity.

Attributes:
    required: Whether a consultation with a healthcare provider is recommended.
    specialty: Recommended clinical specialty (e.g., General Medicine, Cardiology).
    reason: Plain-language rationale for the recommendation.
    emergency_number: Emergency response telephone number when risk is URGENT.

RiskLevel.title: RiskLevel
RiskLevel.description:
Deterministic triage risk tiers.

URGENT takes precedence on any red-flag symptom.

Symptom.title: Symptom
Symptom.description:
Canonical representation of an extracted or user-reported symptom.

Attributes:
    id: Unique identifier for the symptom record.
    name: Normalized canonical symptom name.
    severity: Clinical severity level.
    duration: Structured duration or None if unknown.
    body_location: Anatomical body site or None if systemic.
    source: Provenance of the symptom report.
    extraction_confidence: AI extraction confidence score between 0.0 and 1.0.
